name.description: The title line: The Cellar Stair.

description.description: What look shows. Use a block scalar (|) and wrap at about 72 columns.

exits.description: Direction to destination vnum. Every destination must exist; the content check warns when the way back is missing or leads elsewhere.

doors.description: Doors on exits, by direction. Declare a door on one side only; the loader mirrors it to the room beyond. A closed door blocks the way and hides the exit and whoever is past it from look, exits, and scan. Area resets restore the closed state given here.

flags.description: safe forbids fighting; dark needs a light. Other flags are free for rules.

temple.description: This room is the named deity's temple; sacrifice works here.

position.description: Anchor this room on the area map; rooms without one are placed by walking exits from an anchor. North decreases y, up increases z.

name.description: How messages call it, with its article: the oak door, the iron gate. Players may name it by any word of this.

closed.description: Shut when the area resets. Open is the default.
